desc: The PPU Range Line Ammunition is expertly designed for shooters seeking reliable performance in both recreational and training environments. This Full Metal Jacket (FMJ) ammunition is crafted to deliver consistent accuracy and precision, making it a favored choice among enthusiasts who demand high standards from their firearm supplies. PPU is renowned for its attention to detail and use of quality materials, ensuring that each round of the Range Line series provides dependable results and enhances shooting experiences.
